text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Japanese Oaks has arrived. Air Groove's mother won this race in the past, and Air Groove strives to follow in her footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove wonders how her mother felt when she ran here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She steps onto the track with heightened focus, determined to chase her ideal.
